task.description: OUT-OF-SEQUENCE pre-implementation consult, not the normal WF-02 Step 2d post-implementation gate -- there is no implementation to review yet. The validated REQ-075 design doc (`lib/letflow/design/req075-tenant-administration-routes.md` SS4.2, OQ-7) makes a research-confirmed recommendation that it explicitly refuses to let ELIXIR-DEV implement without prior REVIEWER sign-off: extending `Letflow.Plugs.TenantStatus` (an already-shipped, already-`done` REQ-021 module, mounted by REQ-071) with a NEW check for `status == :inactive`, applying to EVERY HTTP method (not just writes), returning 403 (not the existing 503), with a PLATFORM_ADMIN exemption -- a real behavior-contract change to a module the pipeline already marked `done`. Decide whether to approve this shape as-is or authorize a narrower alternative (e.g. write-methods-only), record the decision and full reasoning in `docs/migration/stage-4-api-surface.md`'s REVIEWER sign-off section, and state the exact implementable shape so Step 2a (ELIXIR-DEV) has zero ambiguity.
acceptance_criteria: Design doc SS4 (both SS4.1 R-Co evidence and SS4.2 recommendation) read in full before deciding
Shipped lib/letflow/plugs/tenant_status.ex and lib/letflow/identity/tenant.ex read directly, not assumed from the design doc's quotes
A decision is reached and recorded: approve the all-methods/403/PLATFORM_ADMIN-exempt shape, or a stated narrower alternative -- either is an acceptable PASS, silence is not
The all-methods-vs-write-only tradeoff is reasoned through explicitly, including whether INV-8's crash-isolation concerns are actually at stake (they are not -- this is a normal authorization check)
Confirmed no DB migration is needed (status column has no DB-level constraint)
Exact implementable shape stated for ELIXIR-DEV: trigger condition, status code, response body shape, method scope, exemption rule
Decision recorded as a dated entry in docs/migration/stage-4-api-surface.md's REVIEWER sign-off section, matching the established per-requirement entry format, AND in this handoff file

result.summary: Reached and recorded a decision: approve SS4.2's recommended shape as-is -- Letflow.Plugs.TenantStatus gets a new check running for ALL HTTP methods, before the existing :migrating write-only check, triggering on status == :inactive AND caller roles not including PLATFORM_ADMIN, rejecting with 403 body {"error": "tenant_inactive", "detail": "tenant is deactivated"} (no Retry-After header), PLATFORM_ADMIN exempt -- matching R-Co's actual auth.zig/service.zig behavior precisely, not the narrower write-only alternative. Reasoning: :migrating already exists as this codebase's write-pause mechanism; making :inactive also write-only would leave a deactivated tenant's callers with full, indefinite read access, which contradicts what deactivation (REQ-075 AC5) is for. INV-8 (crash isolation) does not favor the narrower alternative -- this is a plain authorization branch reusing the plug's existing Repo.get(Tenant, tenant_id) lookup, not a new failure mode needing process-isolation containment; the all-methods tradeoff (a deactivated tenant's caller loses read access, including in-flight polling) was weighed directly and judged correct, not waved through. Checked all 13 docs/migration/decisions/*.md records: no contradiction -- 0003/0006 (schema-per-tenant) don't apply since tenants is already a default-schema table outside that mechanism, and this adds an enum value, not a scoping mechanism; 0013 (five-role matrix) isn't implicated since this reads the same conn.assigns.auth_context.roles source REQ-069/071 already established, no new role. Confirmed directly (not assumed from the design doc's quote) that lib/letflow/identity/tenant.ex:56's status field is Ecto.Enum on a plain :string column with no DB CHECK constraint (priv/repo/migrations/20260816000001_create_tenants.exs) -- no migration needed, only an application-layer values: list extension. Full reasoning and the exact ELIXIR-DEV-ready shape (8 numbered points: enum extension, restructured call/2, trigger condition, exact 403 body/headers, no-trigger fallthrough, unchanged edge cases, single shared Repo.get call preserving fail-closed behavior, moduledoc update) recorded in docs/migration/stage-4-api-surface.md's REVIEWER sign-off section, dated 2026-08-22 (REQ-075, out-of-sequence pre-implementation consult).
result.next_action: ORCH may dispatch Step 2a (ELIXIR-DEV) for REQ-075 -- the SS4.2/OQ-7 gate is now resolved; ELIXIR-DEV must implement Letflow.Plugs.TenantStatus's new :inactive check exactly per the 8-point shape recorded in docs/migration/stage-4-api-surface.md's 2026-08-22 (REQ-075) entry, alongside the rest of the design's six route handlers
